{
  "summary": "This PR implements BIP-119 (OP_CHECKTEMPLATEVERIFY, or CTV) by repurposing OP_NOP4, but limits its soft-fork deployment exclusively to regtest. It implements the template hash verification logic and caches the required hashes in transaction precomputation data. On non-regtest networks, CTV remains unactivated, maintaining existing NOP discouragement behavior.",
  "problem": "Developers designing or experimenting with covenant protocols cannot test BIP-119 transaction templates against Bitcoin Core's codebase without custom out-of-tree builds. Additionally, testing how CTV interacts with other proposed soft-fork opcodes requires an in-tree implementation.",
  "evidence": [
    "Author description: \"This implements BIP-119 (OP_CHECKTEMPLATEVERIFY), but only specifies a regtest deployment. There is no effective policy change, since the SCRIPT_VERIFY_* flags (as used) result in the same NOP-like behavior. This change can be composed with other opcode specifications (e.g. CSFS, CAT) and bundled into the same deployment (yet to be specified).\""
  ],
  "dependencies": {
    "depends_on": [],
    "enables": []
  },
  "scope_notes": "The PR touches consensus validation and script interpreter code, but also includes over 3,000 lines of test vectors and functional test suites (notably ctvhash.json and feature_checktemplateverify.py).",
  "changed_since_previous": "",
  "card": "This PR implements BIP-119 OP_CHECKTEMPLATEVERIFY (replacing OP_NOP4) but confines its activation strictly to regtest networks. It adds template hash calculation and precomputation into the script interpreter and standardizes bare CTV spending scripts on regtest while leaving mainnet and testnet verification unchanged. This enables testing and development of covenant workflows and composition with other proposed opcodes without altering mainnet consensus. Most of the diff consists of test vectors and functional tests for template verification.",
  "needs": [],
  "confidence": "high",

}

result.summary: This PR implements BIP-119 (OP_CHECKTEMPLATEVERIFY, or CTV) by repurposing OP_NOP4, but limits its soft-fork deployment exclusively to regtest. It implements the template hash verification logic and caches the required hashes in transaction precomputation data. On non-regtest networks, CTV remains unactivated, maintaining existing NOP discouragement behavior.

result.card: This PR implements BIP-119 OP_CHECKTEMPLATEVERIFY (replacing OP_NOP4) but confines its activation strictly to regtest networks. It adds template hash calculation and precomputation into the script interpreter and standardizes bare CTV spending scripts on regtest while leaving mainnet and testnet verification unchanged. This enables testing and development of covenant workflows and composition with other proposed opcodes without altering mainnet consensus. Most of the diff consists of test vectors and functional tests for template verification.
